violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) at the bar on top of ice: watermelon purée (49f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE PURÉE

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Fixed Equipment, Properly Spaced and Sealed
violations.observation: The following equipment is not installed in a manner that allows accessibility for cleaning, nor is it installed with closely abutting surfaces to minimize the need for cleaning: 1) drain boards of dishwashing area was observed not fixed to the wall.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment that is fixed because it is not easily movable shall be installed so that it is: 1) spaced to allow access for cleaning along the sides, behind, and above the equipment, 2) spaced from adjoining equipment, walls, and ceilings a distance of not more than 1 millimeter or one thirty-second inch, and 3) sealed to adjoining equipment or walls if the equipment is exposed to spillage or seepage. SEAL/CAULK THE DRAIN BOARDS TO THE WALL.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) the main dish machine was observed not pulling sanitizer. Dish machine was observed not sanitizing.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO USE THE DISH MACHINE TO WASH AND RINSE. SANITIZING MUST OCCUR AT THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK. SOAK DISHES IN QUATERNARY AMMONIA SOLUTION FOR 30-60 SECONDS. ALLOW TO AIR DRY.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: 1) exterior of all coolers along the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. MORE FREQUENT CLEANING IS REQUIRED. PENTHOUSE POOL AND LOUNGE (Inspection Date: 07/24/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: The hand sink across from the dish machine was observed without paper towels.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC REPLENISHED THE PAPER TOWELS.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: The handsink at the bar was observed without a hand washing sign.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. POST A HAND WASHING SIGN AT THIS HANDSINK.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw chicken, Raw shrimp, and Raw bacon were observed being stored over prepared food in the walk in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE RAW ANIMAL PROTEINS TO BOTTOM OF A NEARBY SHELF.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: The hot water in the high temperature dish machine was observed at 149f-159f.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCONTINUE THE USE OF THE DISH MACHINE FOR SANITIZATION. WASHING AND RINSING MAY OCCUR IN THE DISH MACHINE. SANITIZING MUST OCCUR IN THE THREE COMPARTMENT SINK. USING QUATERNARY AMMONIA, SOAK DISHES FOR 30 TO 60 SECONDS AND ALLOW TO AIR DRY. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO CALL THE SERVICE TECHNICIAN FOR REPAIRS.
